---
title: "fesm_fields"
subtitle: "Containers for fields exchanged between components"
---

## Overview

`fesm_fields` holds the fields that cross a component boundary: one
`field_state_t` per side of an exchange (a component instance's exports or
imports), each field a `dp` buffer `v(nx,ny,nz)` with the metadata an exchange
layer needs: units, grid tag, validity interval `[t0,t1]`, time semantics,
conservation flag and an optional valid mask. Fields are resolved to integer
handles at init.

The module is model-agnostic: it knows no field names, does no remapping and no
unit conversion. The vocabulary, the wiring tables and the lags live in the
model (kryos), whose exchange combines `fesm_fields` with `coupler`. It depends
on `precision`, `fesm_log` and `ncio`; public interfaces never use `wp`.

- **One buffer shape.** Rank is metadata: scalars are `v(1,1,1)` with
  `grid = ""`, 2-D fields have `nz = 1`, rank-3 fields (monthly climate, ocean
  profiles) name their third axis in `zdim`. There is no rank 1 yet.
- **Two phases.** Declare (`fields_init`, `fields_add`), then `fields_lock`,
  which allocates every buffer once. `put`, `get`, `finalize_interval` and
  `restart_read` never allocate.
- **Owned copies.** `put` copies in (widening `sp` exactly), `get` copies out
  the **published** value. Components are public: read `st%f(h)` freely, write
  only through `fields_put`.
- **Time semantics.** INSTANT replaces the value on each `put`. MEAN and
  ACCUM accumulate `var*(t1-t0)` over a window that must be contiguous to the
  bit; `fields_finalize_interval(st, t)` publishes the mean (or the integral)
  and clears the window. Accumulators never reset in `get`, so several
  consumers can read one published value.
- **Loud failure.** Every misuse stops through `fesm_error` with the owner and
  the field in the message; there are no `stat` arguments.

## Public API

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `FIELD_INSTANT`, `FIELD_MEAN`, `FIELD_ACCUM` | Time semantics: value at `t1`, mean over `[t0,t1]`, integral over `[t0,t1]` |
| `FIELD_INTENSIVE`, `FIELD_EXTENSIVE` | Conservation flag (remap default `bilin` / `con` in the exchange) |
| `FIELD_NAME_LEN`, `FIELD_UNITS_LEN`, `FIELD_GRID_LEN`, `FIELD_OWNER_LEN` | String lengths (32, 32, 64, 64) |
| `field_t` | One field: metadata, published `v`, `t0`, `t1`, `valid`; open window `acc`, `acc_valid`, `wsum`, `ta0`, `ta1` |
| `field_state_t` | `owner`, `n`, `locked`, `f(1:n)` |
| `fields_init(st, owner)` | Reset `st`; `owner` (`"ice_grl:exports"`) is in every message |
| `fields_add(st, name, units, tsem, cons, h [, grid, dims, zdim, masked, restart])` | Declare a field, return its handle `h`. No `dims`: scalar; `[nx,ny]`; `[nx,ny,nz]`. `restart = .false.`: a diagnostic, not in the restart file |
| `fields_lock(st)` | End the declaration; allocate and zero every buffer |
| `fields_handle(st, name)`, `fields_has(st, name)` | Handle of a name (stops if absent); is it declared |
| `fields_put(st, h, var, t1 [, t0, valid])` | Copy in; generic over `dp`/`sp` and 0-D/2-D/3-D. `t0` required for MEAN/ACCUM; `valid` iff masked |
| `fields_get(st, h, var [, t0, t1, valid])` | Copy out the published value; generic as `put`; `st` is `intent(in)` |
| `fields_finalize_interval(st, t)` | Publish and clear every MEAN/ACCUM window, each of which must end at `t` |
| `fields_check_link(src, hs, dst, hd)` | Stop unless units are equivalent, rank, `nz` and `cons` equal, and the time semantics allowed |
| `fields_describe(st [, level])` | Log a header and one line per field (default `LOG_INFO`) |
| `fields_restart_write(st, filename)`, `fields_restart_read(st, filename)` | The state fields in their own NetCDF file; read checks the declaration matches |
| `units_key(units)` | Lower case, no blanks, `*` or `^`: `"kg m**-2 yr-1"` → `"kgm-2yr-1"` |
| `units_canonical(units)` | `units_key` of the canonical spelling of an accepted alias |
| `units_equivalent(a, b)` | Same units, possibly spelled differently |

A rank-3 array with `size(var,3) == 1` is accepted for a rank-2 field in `put`
and `get`, so an exchange can work on `v(:,:,:)` throughout.

Allowed links (`fields_check_link`); horizontal shape and grid may differ:

| source \\ destination | INSTANT | MEAN | ACCUM |
|---|---|---|---|
| INSTANT | ok | – | – |
| MEAN | ok (last interval's mean) | ok (accumulates; slow consumer) | – |
| ACCUM | – | – | ok |

Unit aliases are identities only (factor 1, offset 0): `kg m-2 yr-1` =
`mm w.e. yr-1` = `kg/m2/yr` = ..., `kg m-2` = `mm w.e.`, `m` = `metre`,
`m yr-1` = `m/a`, `K` = `kelvin`, `W m-2` = `W/m2`, `1` = `fraction`. Units
that need a factor or an offset (`m i.e.`, `degC`) are never equivalent: the
conversion belongs in the adapter.

## Example

```fortran
use precision, only : dp
use fesm_fields

type(field_state_t) :: ex
integer :: h_smb, h_bsl

call fields_init(ex, "srf_grl:exports")
call fields_add(ex, "smb", "kg m-2 yr-1", FIELD_MEAN, FIELD_EXTENSIVE, h_smb, &
                grid="grl-16km", dims=[nx,ny], masked=.true.)
call fields_add(ex, "bsl", "m", FIELD_INSTANT, FIELD_INTENSIVE, h_bsl)
call fields_lock(ex)
call fields_describe(ex)

! In the surface adapter: sub-steps of the coupling interval [ta, tb]
call fields_put(ex, h_smb, smb_sub1, t0=ta, t1=tm, valid=ice_free)
call fields_put(ex, h_smb, smb_sub2, t0=tm, t1=tb, valid=ice_free)
call fields_put(ex, h_bsl, bsl, t1=tb)

! After the component's update: publish the interval mean
call fields_finalize_interval(ex, tb)

! A consumer (or the exchange) reads the published value
call fields_get(ex, h_smb, smb_mean, t0=t0, t1=t1)
```

A mistake stops with the owner and the field, for instance an exchange run
twice for one producer interval:

```
fesm:: error in fesm_fields_put
    gap or overlap in accumulation
    owner = 'ice_grl:imports'
    field = 'smb' (h = 3)
    window = [0.00000000000000000E+000, 1.00000000000000000E+000]
    given  = [0.00000000000000000E+000, 1.00000000000000000E+000]
    t0 < ta1: overlap
  stopped by fesm_error.
```

## Restart

`fields_restart_write` writes the state fields (published values, open windows,
masks, validity) to their own file, `<instance>_fields.nc` by convention:
`<name>`, `<name>_acc`, `<name>_valid`, `<name>_acc_valid` with dimensions
`<grid>_x`, `<grid>_y`, `<zdim>` (scalars on `one`), and the written names as
a global attribute. A diagnostic (`fields_add(..., restart = .false.)`) is not
written: its owner puts it again after a restore, so adding or dropping one
leaves the files readable. `fields_restart_read` stops unless every declared
state field is present with the same shape, units key, `tsem`, `cons` and mask
and the file holds no other field but declared diagnostics (an older file;
ignored and logged); the restored state fields are then bit-identical (ncio reads
`|x| < 1e-30` as 0 and NaN as -9999, which matters only at invalid cells), and
a diagnostic keeps its value.

## Users and next steps

`fesmdata` uses `units_key` from here. kryos builds its exchange
(`kryos_fields_vocab`, `kryos_wiring`) on `fesm_fields` and `coupler`; the
design is in `docs/dev/fields-design.md`. Rank 1 (obm boxes, basin profiles)
is deferred to phase 3; masks are not yet forwarded through a remap (coupler
mask pass-through).

Tests: `make check-fields` (`test/fields/`: nine test programs and one
expected-abort program per error case in `test/fields/abort/`).
